author: Philip K. Dick
card_summary: Canonical record for Mary and the Giant, PKD's novel, preserving a single archive manifestation.
page_summary:
Mary and the Giant is the canonical works record for PKD's novel. It preserves a single archive manifestation and gives the work a stable bibliographic home. The preserved item here is Mary and the Giant (1987).

Researchers can use this entry to trace publication context, later commentary, and relationships to other works.

biography_events.event: Phil works steadily at University Music on Telegraph Avenue in Berkeley, advising customers on classical recordings and absorbing the catalog knowledge that he will draw on throughout the fiction; he attends UC Berkeley briefly without completing a term.
biography_events.source: Sutin; Anne R. Dick (The Search, on the record-store milieu)
